title: Lead Database Administrator
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your Role You will manage and administer the physical and technical aspects of database systems, including base definition, structure, documentation, long-range requirements, operational guidelines, and protection, while potentially interacting with clients (internal or external) in order to understand and meet requirements for the delivery of services related to database products. What you will do Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, installation and maintenance of the database system, installation of upgrades and patches, performance and capacity monitoring/management, and security compliance, along with proposing and implementing enhancements that will improve the performance and reliability of the system. Your Future at Kyndryl Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important, you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused, someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless, naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Qualifications 15+ years data/database architecture, 7+ years migration/modernization; Cloud data/database architect. Proven hands-on experience administering, configuring, and maintaining enterprise database management systems. Strong background in database operations, performance tuning, and troubleshooting complex database issues. Solid understanding of High Availability (HA), backup/recovery, and Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies. Experience enforcing database security policies, access controls, and threat protection measures. Ability to perform capacity planning, growth projections, and system scalability assessments. Skill in authoring clear technical documentation and shaping foundational system definitions. Strong collaboration skills to partner with application developers, migration engineers, and cross-functional teams. Analytical problem-solving mindset with a commitment to reliability and operational excellence. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting database migration initiatives and providing shared database services to migration squads. Hands-on familiarity with multiple major database platforms and cross-platform administration. Experience with cloud database services, automation, or infrastructure-as-code practices. Background working in regulated or enterprise industries such as banking or retail. Relevant database platform certifications or active progress toward multi-platform certification. Experience proposing and driving continuous performance, reliability, or cost-efficiency improvements. Proven track record coordinating multi-team technical project plans aligned with business objectives. Comfort operating in diverse, global, and cross-cultural engineering teams. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
company_description:
Kyndryl is the world's largest provider of IT infrastructure services serving thousands of enterprise customers in more than 60 countries. 

We design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical information technology the world depends on every day. Our business quite literally powers the vital systems that run banks, stock markets, airlines, automotive and healthcare companies, governments and more. 

Kyndryl is at the heart of progress — dedicated to helping companies and people grow strong. With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Our people are actively discovering, co-creating, and strengthening. We push ourselves and each other to seek better, to go further, and we carry this energy to our customers. 

Core to our culture is maintaining an inclusive, engaging and flexible work environment for our employees. We have embraced a flexible workplace policy that helps Kyndryl employees achieve business results and work-life balance. Many of our jobs can be done flexibly and we actively encourage our managers and employees to have open discussions around what works best for them.  We care about our employees well-being and pride ourselves on offering benefits that give choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support them and their family through the moments that matter – wherever they are in their life journey.

title: Specialist, ServiceNow Automation Engineer
description: Job Description Additional location(s) Compensation Information: Required Skills: Availability Management, Capacity Management, Change Controls, Configuration Management (CM), Design Applications, Incident Management, Information Technology (IT) Infrastructure, IT Service Management (ITSM), Software Configurations, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Solution Architecture, System Administration, System Designs Preferred Skills: Current Employees applyHERE Current Contingent Workers applyHERE Secondary Language(s) Job Description: The Opportunity Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare. Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats. Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy. A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers. Role Overview TheServiceNow Service Catalog Automation Engineer designs, builds, and maintains intelligent request fulfillment workflows and digital experiences across the enterprise ServiceNow platform. Operating within the Technical Project Management product line, this role is instrumental in modernizing self-service delivery, streamlining IT and business request lifecycles, and engineering bi-directional integrations between ServiceNow and external enterprise systems. The ideal candidate blends deep technical mastery of ServiceNow Service Portal / Employee Center architecture, robust JavaScript/Glide API development, and hands-on integration engineering (REST/SOAP, IntegrationHub, external web services) to maximize workforce productivity, governance, and operational integrity. What will you do in this role 1. Service Catalog Portal Development End-to-End Catalog Engineering: Design, build, and maintain complex Service Catalog items, variable sets, record producers, order guides, and execution plans adhering to enterprise UI/UX and governance standards. Portal Experience: Configure, customize, and optimize the ServiceNow Service Portal and Employee Center (widgets, pages, CSS/SCSS, AngularJS/HTML) to provide intuitive, accessible self-service experiences. Knowledge Management: Administer and integrate the ServiceNow Knowledge Base within request workflows to promote self-resolution and automated request deflection. 2. Workflow Automation Process Engineering Workflow Orchestration: Develop, test, and maintain automated workflows using Flow Designer, Workflow Editor, and IntegrationHub to automate approvals, task routing, notifications, and fulfillment tasks. Platform Scripting: Implement clean, maintainable server-side and client-side logic utilizing Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and UI Actions following platform best practices. Security Access Control: Formulate and maintain Access Control Lists (ACLs), roles, and delegation groups to enforce least-privilege security and data integrity. 3. Enterprise Integration External System Connectivity API Development Integration: Design and deploy robust inbound and outbound integrations using REST and SOAP web services, IntegrationHub spokes, scripted web services, and MID Servers. System Interoperability: Connect ServiceNow with enterprise systems (e.g., Identity Access Management, ERP, HR systems, IT Asset Management, monitoring platforms, and third-party SaaS applications). Data Layer CMDB Alignment: Align catalog data architecture with the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) and ServiceNow Common Service Data Model (CSDM) to ensure consistent data modeling and asset tracking. 4. Governance, Quality Assurance DevOps Code Quality Testing: Write modular, maintainable code; utilize ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) alongside modern automated testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, Mocha, Chai) and linting tools (ESLint) to safeguard releases. Agile Release Management: Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, manage update sets and scoped applications, and adhere to strict CI/CD and deployment governance. Architecture Collaboration: Partner with solution architects, platform owners, and cross-functional engineering teams to evaluate new platform capabilities, technical debt, and scalability roadmaps. What should you have Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 5 years of hands-on experience in IT software/platform engineering, with a minimum of3–4 years dedicated to ServiceNow development, catalog engineering, and platform administration. Technical Competencies ServiceNow Core Platform: Deep technical expertise in Service Catalog, Service Portal / Employee Center, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, CMDB, and Incident/Change/Request modules. Scripting Web Technologies: Advanced proficiency in JavaScript (ES5/ES6), ServiceNow APIs (GlideSystem, GlideRecord, GlideAjax), HTML5, CSS/SCSS, XML, JSON, and AngularJS. Integration Protocols: Demonstrated success building and troubleshooting integrations using REST/SOAP web services, OAuth 2.0, API key authentication, and webhook architectures. Database Data Modeling: Solid understanding of relational database principles, SQL/PostgreSQL/Oracle query concepts, and data mapping within the ServiceNow schema. Development Tooling: Working knowledge of code management (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and testing suites (ATF, ESLint, Mocha/Chai/Jest). Soft Skills Global Teamwork Proven track record of collaborating across global, multicultural engineering teams in an Agile/DevOps environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical architectures to non-technical stakeholders. Self-directed problem solver with strong analytical, debugging, and system diagnostic abilities. Preferred Qualifications Certifications ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in IT Service Management (ITSM) or Service Mapping / Discovery Experience operating within regulated industries (e.g., GxP, SOX, HIPAA) and adhering to validated change-control standards. Who we are We are known as Merck Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been inventing for life, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the worlds most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world. What we look for Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today. #MSDHYDIT Search Firm Representatives Please Read Carefully Merck Co., Inc., Rahway, NJ, USA, also known as Merck Sharp Dohme LLC, Rahway, NJ, USA, does not accept unsolicited assistance from search firms for employment opportunities. No fee will be paid in the event a candidate is hired by our company as a result of an agency referral where no pre-existing agreement is in place. The role combines hands-on software development with production support, on-call escalation management, incident troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of application reliability and customer experience. Key Responsibilities The Developer and Production Support Engineer will design, build, test, deploy, and support Java/Kotlin-based applications. The role combines hands-on software development with production support, on-call escalation management, incident troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of application reliability and customer experience. Skill Requirements Java and/or Kotlin development experience • Spring Boot • Mockito • Gradle • JBoss application server • Git source control • GitLab CI and CI/CD pipeline implementation • Hibernate and JPA • Docker • General database platform knowledge across cloud and on-premises environments • Scripting experience with Bash, PowerShell, and/or Python • Production support, incident troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and SLA-driven ticket resolution Must Have Skill Java Good to Have Skill Other Requirements Preferred Skills • Puppet configuration-management experience • Monitoring and observability experience with tools such as Grafana, Elastic Stack (ELK), Splunk, and Slack-based operational integrations • CyberArk integration experience • ServiceNow development or platform integration experience Behavioral Competencies • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently during incidents • Effective communication and collaboration across development, support, infrastructure, database, security, and business teams • Customer-focused approach with attention to quality, compliance, documentation, and timely resolution • Ability to balance planned development work with operational support and on-call responsibilities Success Measures • SLA compliance and timely ticket resolution • Reduction in repeat incidents, rejected resolutions, and reopened cases • Improved first-call resolution and customer satisfaction (CSAT) • Quality and maintainability of application code, pipelines, scripts, runbooks, and knowledge articles • Effective root cause analysis and completion of preventive actions

title: Lead PostgreSQL DBA
description: EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential. We are seeking an experienced Lead PostgreSQL DBA to join our team and drive the automation, validation, and hardening of our critical database environments. In this role, you will design resilient recovery solutions across a diverse multi-database ecosystem while leveraging cloud platforms and modern DevOps practices to safeguard mission-critical data. database engineering and administration Expertise in hands-on administration, replication, and recovery across SQL Server, Oracle, and PostgreSQL Proficiency in managing and recovering MySQL, MongoDB, Database Data Modeling: Solid understanding of relational database principles, SQL/PostgreSQL/Oracle query concepts, and data mapping within the ServiceNow schema. Development Tooling: Working knowledge of code management (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and testing suites (ATF, ESLint, Mocha/Chai/Jest). Self-directed problem solver with strong analytical, debugging, and system diagnostic abilities.
